item.title: Battlefield 6 Controversy Erupts Over Dev Brian Odet’s Political Posts About Charlie Kirk’s Death
item.description: Yep. The Battlefield franchise has never been shy of chaos. Usually, the drama stays inside the game, crumbling skyscrapers, jets colliding midair, the usual spectacle.
